feed.headline: Why U.S. Business Deals Are Unlikely to Get Putin to Give Any Ground
feed.ai: President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia has shown a willingness to endure a high price to get what he wants in Ukraine, and he sees little reason to stop fighting now, analysts say.

feed.headline: Egypt reopens Tripoli embassy after 12 years and raises concerns over Turkey-Libya maritime deal
feed.ai: Egypt is seeking closer ties with Libya’s western government after years of backing its eastern rival. Talks in Tripoli covered energy projects and Egypt’s objections to Libya’s maritime deal with Turkey.

feed.headline: A.I. Weapons Need Data for Their Training. Ukraine Has a Lot to Offer.
feed.ai: The Ukrainian government has opened up a trove of five million battlefield videos to defense companies at home and abroad.

feed.headline: Seeking to Broaden Ukraine Talks, U.S. Urges Russia to Include Europe
feed.ai: As a round of negotiations ended in Abu Dhabi, President Trump’s envoys said they would go to Moscow as the Kremlin demands discussions on European security structures.

feed.headline: Protesters Throw Projectiles at Biden During Dublin Trip
feed.ai: Video showed demonstrators from a pro-Palestinian protest throwing projectiles at former President Joseph R. Biden Jr. after he attended an event at Trinity College Dublin on Tuesday.

feed.headline: Judge Allows Trump’s Defamation Lawsuit Against the BBC to Proceed
feed.ai: President Trump is seeking damages from the British broadcaster over a documentary it conceded was misleadingly edited.

feed.headline: This Defense Makes Drones (and GPS) Think They’re in Peru
feed.ai: GPS-linked devices have been insisting that Ukrainians are in Lima, the Peruvian capital. The culprit is a jamming system built to thwart Russian airstrikes.

feed.headline: Spain: 120,000 brave rain to demand affordable housing and better wages
feed.ai: Around 120,000 demonstrators marched through central Madrid on Wednesday 11 November, according to authorities, as Spain's first nationwide general strike since 2012 brought crowds onto the streets to protest against soaring housing costs and mounting pressure on household budgets.

feed.headline: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years
feed.ai: Protests are also expected in the biggest cities less than three weeks before Spaniards vote in parliamentary elections.
